translations.web: I have taken off my robe. Indeed, must I put it on? I have washed my feet. Indeed, must I soil them?
translations.bsb: I have taken off my robe— must I put it back on? I have washed my feet— must I soil them again?
translations.kjv: I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile
translations.asv: I have put off my garment; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?
